answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 9 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the vault release is published with every signature, the jade audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the onyx graph and each risks its bond. A farm of 204 pays that 20 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
